message.content:
Yes—**early Coca-Cola did contain cocaine**, because its original formula used coca leaf extract that included the drug.[1][7] Coca-Cola says **it does not contain cocaine now**, and that cocaine has **never been an added ingredient** in the modern product.[2]

A few details matter:

- In the late 1800s, cocaine was legal and used in some medicines, so it was part of the drink’s original formulation.[1][7]
- Coca-Cola later removed the cocaine-containing ingredient from the formula in the early 1900s.[7]
- The company still uses **de-cocainized** coca leaf extract for flavoring today, but not cocaine itself.[7][2]

So the accurate short answer is: **yes, historically; no, not in today’s Coca-Cola**.[1][2][7]
